code:
(define (make-counter)
  (let ((count 0))           ; the environment the closure captures
    (lambda ()               ; the lambda forms the closure
      (set! count (+ count 1))
      count)))

(define counter1 (make-counter))
(define counter2 (make-counter))

(counter1)                   ; 1
(counter1)                   ; 2
(counter2)                   ; 1
(counter1)                   ; 3
description: make-counter returns a closure that captures its own count variable, allowing multiple independent counters.
